reuse.why: Linking reuses the SimpleFin link flow (bank grouping, account creation/upgrade, initial sync) and the existing guardBankAccountLink wrapper; the download path follows the per-provider pattern instead of sharing anything.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a compacted copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (token, post, error mapping, response shaping), adding one more copy of that block.

placement.why: Server URL in server-config, provider in SYNC_PROVIDERS, type in types/models, link in accounts/app.ts and download in accounts/sync.ts, matching where every other provider lives.

scope.why: Focused on the provider; the extra updatedPreview field in an existing SimpleFin test mock is a small unrelated touch.

maintainability.why: Fintegra now runs through a function named linkSimpleFinAccount with a provider parameter and an `'orgDomain' in externalAccount` special case, which hides the dependency; the download copy must be kept in sync with the others.

disguised_duplication.where: accounts/sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions restates downloadAkahuTransactions in a condensed form (merged else-if, inline return) rather than sharing it
